goals.title: 사용자는 역사적으로 기독교적·선교적 정신으로 세워진 주식회사들이 그 정신을 정관에 어떻게 담았는지 공개 자료로 조사해 달라고...
goals.objective: 사용자는 역사적으로 기독교적·선교적 정신으로 세워진 주식회사들이 그 정신을 정관에 어떻게 담았는지 공개 자료로 조사해 달라고 요청했다. 한국어로, 회사별 설립 배경과 실제 정관 조항을 구분하고 원문 인용 및 공식 출처를 제공한다. 법률 자문이 아님을 명시하며, 주장마다 근거를 남긴다. 조사 산출물 형식은 사용자 승인을 받은 뒤 시작한다.

successCriteria.scenario: Read the completed Korean report and open every cited primary charter or governing instrument link; verify each presented case identifies its jurisdiction, entity form, founding/mission source, governing-instrument clause, implementation mechanism, and caveat.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-research/20260918-231935/REPORT.pdf plus REPORT.docx, SYNTHESIS.md, and source-link audit transcript showing all cited primary-source URLs were opened or marked inaccessible with a reason.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-research/20260918-231935/REPORT.pdf, REPORT.docx, SYNTHESIS.md and source-link-audit.tsv; 30 URLs audited (21 open, 9 marked inaccessible/error); independent final visual approval PASS; tree:no-git | cleanup: removed report-render temp directories; no runtime processes or live workers.

successCriteria.scenario: Inspect the report’s treatment of an inaccessible, non-public, or legally different source: it must label the entity form, avoid overclaiming a mission statement as a charter, record the access result, and preserve the legal-counsel limitation.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-research/20260918-231935/source-link-audit.tsv, claim-graph.md unresolved annex, and REPORT.md sections 1, 2 and 6.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-research/20260918-231935/source-link-audit.tsv records inaccessible/error outcomes; claim-graph.md U-01/U-02 and REPORT.md §§1, 2, 6 label legal form, inaccessible evidence and counsel limits; tree:no-git | cleanup: removed report-render temp directories; no runtime processes or live workers.

successCriteria.scenario: Open the final PDF, final DOCX, and source audit after the last report edit; verify PDF has seven readable A4 pages, DOCX preserves hyperlinks and visible list numbering, and the source audit count remains consistent with the report.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Fresh visual-QA reviewer verdicts, pdfinfo output, DOCX unzip/XML checks, and `.omo/ulw-research/20260918-231935/source-link-audit.tsv`.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-research/20260918-231935/final-audit.txt confirms 7-page A4 tagged PDF, valid DOCX and 30 external hyperlinks; fresh independent visual reviewers PASS and confirmed source list ends at 17; tree:no-git | cleanup: removed report-render temp directories; no runtime processes or live workers.
